decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis displacement initiates at index 685: U jumps +15 MAD, E drops −3 MAD, N dips −4 MAD with delay; U and E remain offset through 729 with only partial E recovery and no U return. No opposing return observed in allowed context [645,729], so the interval is classified as uncertain temporary offset. The earlier trend (500–664) lies outside allowed_context and is excluded.

intervals.observation: U: sharp upward jump ~685 (from ~−10 to ~+5 MAD), sustained plateau through 729 with no return; E: sharp drop ~685 (from ~−13 to ~−16 MAD), partial recovery to ~−14 by 695 but remains offset; N: delayed dip peaking ~690 (~−4 MAD) then recovers toward pre-event level by ~695. Return not observed in U or E within allowed context; interior shows stable offset, not smooth motion. Coherent multi-axis onset supports transient displacement, but absence of opposing return makes status uncertain.
